The '''Frozen Geode''' is a [[Minerals|Mineral]] deposit that contains [[minerals]], [[artifacts]], ores, or basic [[:Category:Resources|resources]]. It can be found on floors 41 to 79 of [[the Mines]], on [[the Farm]] in the [[Winter]], or inside a [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chest]]. It can also be received as a gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. An [[Ice Pip]] [[Fish Pond]] may produce 1 or 5 Frozen Geodes when the population of the pond reaches 9. Frozen Geodes can also be obtained by pickaxing [[Mining#Frozen Geode Node|Frozen Geode Nodes]]. These are found in the small quarry on the [[Farm Maps#Hilltop|Hill-top Farm]] and [[Farm Maps#Four Corners|Four Corners Farm]]. [[Sebastian]] sells Frozen Geodes in his [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s.

The Frozen Geode can be broken open by [[Clint]] in the [[Blacksmith|Blacksmith shop]] for {{Price|25}} or by using a [[Geode Crusher]].

Neither daily [[luck]] nor luck [[buffs]] affect the contents of a Frozen Geode.

===Resources===
Note that [[Gold Ore]] is available in the Frozen Geode only after the player has reached floor 76 of [[the Mines]]. Before reaching floor 76, Iron Ore is substituted when breaking open a Frozen Geode. Except for clay and stone, the following items will be obtained in the following amounts: 30% for 1, 30% for 3, 30% for 5, 9% for 10, and 1% for 20. Stone has a 50% chance to use those values and a 50% chance to give only 1. Only 1 clay can be obtained from a single geode.

==Tailoring==
Frozen Geode is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt161|link=Tailoring{{!}}Blue Hoodie|class=inline}}. It is a cyan dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the blue dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
*Five Frozen Geodes may be requested by [[Ice Pip]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
*One Frozen Geode may be requested by several ocean fish in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5.
*Five Frozen Geodes may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fifth request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth.

==External Links==
Users with access to their [[Saves|saved game files]] may find the "Stardew Predictor" utility helpful for predicting which items will be produced from breaking open geodes.  The utility is located at: https://mouseypounds.github.io/stardew-predictor/
